primary: Independent end-to-end success, complete requested actions and faithful locally cited answer; schema compliance alone never counts as success.
treatment: Only /api/chat format on planner requests. Same system/user prompts, native tools, finalizer, grounder, fresh memory, temporary project and validators. No schema inserted into the prompt in B.
order: E current/schema only if H changes validity or execution
extension: Only if independent end-to-end benefit appears without critical regression: two further warm paired trials for H/E/B, then the frozen holdout below, without tuning. Otherwise stop the campaign. No finalization/model experiment unless the first results justify it.
adopt: Executable-plan gain, independent end-to-end gain on critical and unseen tasks, no critical regression or false success, acceptable measured cost. Otherwise KEEP CURRENT when no real gain; INCONCLUSIVE for insufficient or obstructed comparison.
review: Static independent review against exact fixture contents, executed MCP arguments/results and source mappings; not a second model judge, not an additional human review. Check every factual assertion and citation, omissions, abstention, exact-code requests and declared goal_achieved separately from benchmark success.
